author: alexs0711
quote:
Nothing exciting about any of the characters. Jason is super boring and acts like he is always depressed. No personality or anything to say. And acts like a simp. Then the missions are boring and dry. They all feel like side missions or errands. They actually have you buying flowers and tampons for Lucia. The lady that hid that she was pregnant with his child. 

Where is the dark humor that made GTA great. Like in GTA 5 of Life Invader of blowing a guys head off on live tv. Or San Andreas of burying a guy alive in a porta potty with cement. All these missions in GTA6 are basic. Drop this off, pick that up and meet this person. The first several hours are boring without any exciting cutscenes. There is also no prostitutes, certain cars cannot be stolen, and some NPC's cannot even get attacked and no properties can be purchased, don't think there is even any gambling. Whole game feels like you're playing Sims and just trying to make Lucia happy. The story plot is also horrible. Definitely not what I expected from GTA. Bad characters, no worthy missions, no dark humor.
